items.title: Natural Gas Cash Market Haunted by Weak Demand
items.summary: Natural gas spot prices tumbled Friday under the weight of exceptionally mild November forecasts, though southern Transco markets bucked the widespread selloff, widening an already sharp price divide with northern locations.

items.title: Mother Nature Spooks Weekly Natural Gas Spot Prices
items.summary: Weekly natural gas cash prices fell across the Lower 48 as mild weather staved off heating demand and sent buyers to the sidelines.

items.title: TotalEnergies Sees LNG Prices Moving Higher as Iran War Squeezes Supply
items.summary: TotalEnergies reported double-digit increases for its LNG sales in the third quarter and expects even higher prices through the end of the year as the Iran war continues with no end in sight.

items.title: Chevron Advancing Microsoft Natural Gas Project Despite Texas Data Center Clouds
items.summary: Chevron management said they remained on track with a natural gas-fired power plant in West Texas that would deliver power to a Microsoft data center.

items.title: Natural Gas Prices Battle Bearish Fundamentals
items.summary: Natural gas futures on the New York Mercantile Exchange limped into midday as traders sized up a bearish storage result and expectations for another as weather wanes and production climbs. Robust LNG demand provided a counterweight.

items.title: Curtailments Dent DTM Volumes as Natural Gas Demand Wave Builds
items.summary: DT Midstream (DTM) expects Appalachian producers to hold back natural gas through the fourth quarter even as it lines up expansions for a demand ramp from LNG and power generation.

items.title: ST LNG Project Offshore Texas Clears Key Regulatory Hurdle
items.summary: QatarEnergy has developed a new strategy to further build its global LNG portfolio with long-term offtake from other suppliers to generate revenue if exports are disrupted in the Strait of Hormuz in the future.

items.title: Low European Storage Levels Signal Potential LNG Volatility, BP Says
items.summary: BP management said its gas marketing and trading division posted results “significantly higher” than the previous quarter as European and Asian natural gas prices spiked amid the conflict in Iran.
